# Synthetic proxy list for parser tests. Every address is from 192.0.2.0/24
# (RFC 5737 documentation range) so nothing here can resolve to a real host.
# Lines starting with # have no "://" and are themselves no-scheme test cases.
#
# --- valid tg:// links, hex secrets ---
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.1&port=443&secret=ee1a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.2&port=443&secret=dd1a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.3&port=8443&secret=7g8SNBVWeJisNO3q8VZ4mHM
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.4&port=80&secret=ee0011223344556677889900aabbccdd
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.5&port=8080&secret=ee0011223344556677889900aabbccde
# --- valid, fake-TLS style secret with a hostname suffix ---
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.6&port=443&secret=eeaabbccddeeff00112233445566778877772e6d6963726f736f66742e636f6d
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.7&port=443&secret=eeaabbccddeeff00112233445566778877772e676f6f676c652e636f6d
# --- valid, base64 secrets in all four alphabets ---
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.8&port=443&secret=7gABAgMEBQYHCAkKCwwNDg8
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.9&port=443&secret=7gABAgMEBQYHCAkKCwwNDg8=
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.10&port=443&secret=7g-_AgMEBQYHCAkKCwwNDg8
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.11&port=443&secret=7g+/AgMEBQYHCAkKCwwNDg8=
# --- valid https://t.me/proxy form ---
https://t.me/proxy?server=192.0.2.12&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344ff
https://t.me/proxy?server=192.0.2.13&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344fe
http://t.me/proxy?server=192.0.2.14&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344fd
https://t.me/proxy/?server=192.0.2.15&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344fc
# --- unusual but currently accepted: any scheme with :// and the three params ---
# these pin current behaviour, they are not an endorsement of it
socks5://192.0.2.16?server=192.0.2.16&port=1080&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344fb
javascript://x?server=192.0.2.17&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344fa
file://localhost?server=192.0.2.18&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344f9
# --- param order shuffled, extra params present ---
tg://proxy?secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344f8&port=443&server=192.0.2.19
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.20&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344f7&utm_source=channel
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.21&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344f6&comment=fast
# --- the .& typo, which the parser repairs (first occurrence only) ---
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.22.&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344f5
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.23.&port=443.&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344f4
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.24&port=443.&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344f3
# --- leading and trailing whitespace, tabs ---
   tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.25&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344f2
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.26&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344f1
	tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.27&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344f0
# --- hostile values that must survive as inert text ---
tg://proxy?server=<script>alert(1)</script>&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344ef
tg://proxy?server=" onerror="alert(1)&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344ee
tg://proxy?server=%3Cimg%20src%3Dx%20onerror%3Dalert(1)%3E&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344ed
tg://proxy?server=javascript:alert(1)&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344ec
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.28&port=443&secret=ee11223344556677889900112233'44eb
# --- unicode and punycode hosts ---
tg://proxy?server=пример.рф&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344ea
tg://proxy?server=xn--e1afmkfd.xn--p1ai&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344e9
tg://proxy?server=例え.テスト&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344e8
# --- IPv6 literal in the server param ---
tg://proxy?server=[2001:db8::1]&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344e7
tg://proxy?server=2001:db8::2&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344e6
#
# ============ REJECTED: no scheme ============
192.0.2.30:443:ee1122334455667788990011223344e5
proxy?server=192.0.2.31&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344e4
tg:proxy?server=192.0.2.32&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344e3
t.me/proxy?server=192.0.2.33&port=443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344e2

# ============ port boundaries ============
# 0 and -1 and 65536 and 70000 are rejected; 1 and 65535 are kept

tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.43&port=-1&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344d8
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.44&port=1&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344d7
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.45&port=65535&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344d6
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.46&port=65536&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344d5
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.47&port=70000&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344d4
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.48&port=99999999&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344d3
# currently accepted: parseInt stops at the first non-digit
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.49&port=443abc&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344d2
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.50&port=443.9&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344d1
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.51&port=+443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344d0
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.52&port=%20443&secret=ee1122334455667788990011223344cf

# ============ SKIPPED as spam: a long AAAA run in the secret ============
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.62&port=443&secret=eeAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA112233

tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.64&port=443&secret=ee1122AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA334455667788
# a 19-A run is one short of the trigger and stays valid
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.65&port=443&secret=eeAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA112233
# ============ spam check runs AFTER the port check ============
# bad port wins, so this counts as rejected rather than skipped
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.66&port=0&secret=eeAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA112233
tg://proxy?server=192.0.2.67&port=99999&secret=eeAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA112233
